note: These are proposed hypotheses, not validated strategies or betting recommendations. No external preregistration receipt, locked forecast or settled ticket exists. IDs are local project identifiers, not real-world data.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted spread
strategies.hypothesis: A regularized pregame offense/defense rating may improve margin forecasts over the frozen B0 scoring-rate benchmark.
strategies.inputs: Official dated game results; opponent identity; venue; information available before kickoff
strategies.target: Home margin and signed home handicap
strategies.failure_test: Walk-forward margin error versus B0; exact-price net returns; no test-set parameter tuning
strategies.missing: Full dated training history, frozen model, holdout predictions and independently verified operator rulebook

strategies.name: Pace and efficiency total
strategies.hypothesis: Pregame play volume and efficiency may improve total-points forecasts; scoring variance and pushes must be modeled explicitly.
strategies.inputs: Official play/game counts, pregame efficiency, venue and weather if verified
strategies.failure_test: Chronological proper-score/error improvement; price-aware out-of-sample ROI after costs
strategies.missing: Dated play-level history, verified weather and calibrated score distribution

strategies.name: Calibrated moneyline
strategies.hypothesis: A calibrated home/away/tie distribution may improve proper scoring over a contemporaneous two-way normalized market benchmark.
strategies.inputs: Locked three-outcome probabilities; exact two-/three-way operator contract; source-timed paired prices
strategies.target: Home/away/tie probabilities and fair decimal odds
strategies.failure_test: Brier/log-loss comparison, calibration and matched contract checks; no conversion of a mean margin into a probability without a distribution
strategies.missing: Prospective model probabilities, tie rules, accepted prices and closing snapshots

strategies.name: Cross-game two-leg ticket
strategies.hypothesis: Two individually validated legs may offer value only if a jointly validated probability exceeds the exact combined-price break-even threshold.
strategies.inputs: Both legs' complete evidence; exact combined quote; matched threshold-outcome history; common-factor checks
strategies.failure_test: Do not assume independent games or multiply marginal probabilities by default; resample portfolio returns by NFL week
strategies.missing: Empirical joint-outcome sample, calibrated joint model and executable combined quote

strategies.name: Same-game score combinations
strategies.hypothesis: A discrete joint score model may price spread/total combinations better than multiplying marginal prices.
strategies.inputs: Paired score outcomes at actual thresholds; exact same-game combined quote; verified push/void repricing terms
strategies.failure_test: No use of cross-team seasonal r as a same-game bet correlation; no SGP payout inferred from single-leg odds
strategies.missing: Same-game quote, operator repricing rules and matched out-of-sample calibration

strategies.name: QB volume and receiver combo
strategies.hypothesis: A shared-drive model for QB attempts, receiving opportunity and yards may describe joint QB/receiver outcomes, subject to confirmed participation.
strategies.inputs: Player-game identities, starts/snaps, attempts, targets, official stats and exact threshold quotes
strategies.failure_test: Use player appearances, not team games, for player rates; training sample must match players/roles and thresholds
strategies.missing: Unambiguous prop lines/prices, player-game sample, confirmed starters and joint-model validation

strategies.name: RB workload combinations
strategies.hypothesis: Carry share and receiving opportunity may jointly describe a running back's rushing/receiving outcomes, without assuming a fixed script correlation.
strategies.inputs: Official appearances, snaps/touches, role and verified injury/participation reports
strategies.failure_test: DNP is not a zero; separate workload uncertainty from efficiency and verify settlement rules
strategies.missing: Dated workload sample, clear primary prices, DNP rules and measured threshold correlation

strategies.name: Cross-game player prop pair
strategies.hypothesis: Props in separate games may diversify some exposures, but common model, weather or market errors can still correlate outcomes.
strategies.inputs: Complete individual prop evidence, common-factor analysis, exact combined price and locked joint forecast
strategies.failure_test: Different games do not certify rho=0; validate paired hit rates and joint uncertainty
strategies.missing: Verified player prop quotes and a pregame joint-outcome model
